_comment: Ground truth for the rules engine on the Venkateshulu fixture. The integration test asserts on (rule_id, target_role, deadline_date, severity) for each item — UUIDs and generated_at timestamps are excluded because they are non-deterministic per run. P021 ('within four weeks of disbursement') is anchored to judgment_date in the prototype; the contingent-anchor case ('of disbursement') is a known simplification deferred to Round 2.
